name: Trivia Champ
tagline: Race around a holo-wheel, answer questions, collect all the category wedges.

modes.name: Standard
modes.description: Collect 4 wedges, then answer a final question at the hub (about 20 minutes).

modes.name: Quick
modes.description: First to 3 wedges wins, no final question (about 8 minutes).
howTo: Type !roll, then pick where to move with !1, !2… (numbers appear on the board).
Answer with !1–!4 within 30 seconds. Right: roll again. Wrong: next player.
Answer right on a category HQ (big hexagon) to earn its wedge.
The first player with 3 wedges wins. No final question.

modes.name: Classic
modes.description: All 6 wedges plus the final question, like the board game (about 40 minutes).

commands.help: roll the die on your turn
pick where to move, then answer (30 s per question)
mods: change a category (e.g. !bg cat 6 sports)
